crossRefs.note: The Jews therefore marveled, saying, “How does this man know letters, having never been educated?”
They said, “Isn’t this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then does he say, ‘I have come…
Coming into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished, and said, “Where did this…
Isn’t this the carpenter, the son of Mary, and brother of James, Joses, Judah, and Simon? Aren’t his sisters here with…
All testified about him, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth, and they said, “Isn’t…
Others said, “This is the Christ.” But some said, “What, does the Christ come out of Galilee?
Hasn’t the Scripture said that the Christ comes of the offspring of David, and from Bethlehem, the village where David…
A shoot will come out of the stock of Jesse, and a branch out of his roots will bear fruit.
He was taken away by oppression and judgment. As for his generation, who considered that he was cut off out of the land…
“Behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that I will raise to David a righteous Branch, and he will reign as king and…
Their prince will be one of them, and their ruler will proceed from among them. I will cause him to draw near, and he…
But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, being small among the clans of Judah, out of you one will come out to me that is to be…
They said to him, “In Bethlehem of Judea, for this is written through the prophet,
‘You Bethlehem, land of Judah, are in no way least among the princes of Judah: for out of you shall come a governor…
In his humiliation, his judgment was taken away. Who will declare His generation? For his life is taken from the earth.”

parallels.note: They answered that they didn’t know where it was from.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: However we know where this man comes from, but when the Christ comes, no one will know where he comes from.”
translations.bsb: But we know where this man is from. When the Christ comes, no one will know where He is from.”
translations.kjv: Howbeit we know this man whence he is: but when Christ cometh, no man knoweth whence he is.
translations.asv: Howbeit we know this man whence he is: but when the Christ cometh, no one knoweth whence he is.
